identity.revision: increments only when canonical visible snapshot fingerprint changes

SnapshotPort.required: Use existing protected store and canonical ACCEPT or valid current USER_REVIEW_SUMMARY receipts. Never manufacture a receipt; fence owner/policy/source revisions.

IncrementalSyncPort.required: Acceptance is not completion. Commit cursor only after accepted data durable store; retain original source/job/lease policy. No account access by report module.

ReportRepository.required: Reuse existing protected ledger; share DB changes as integration patch, not direct overwrite. Transaction checks enabled generation and current owner.

DeliveryAdapter.required: No live adapter enabled this task; no ACK implies no DELIVERED. ACK validates exact envelope/destination correlation. Provider acceptance is not recipient read confirmation.

forbidden: DRY_RUN_RECORDED -> ACKNOWLEDGED without real provider ACK
mark coverage COMPLETE when synchronization scope is unknown

scheduler.engine: Existing Android WorkManager schedule/ensure after source audit
scheduler.registration: Unique work names + persistent ledger unique report keys; KEEP/UPDATE policy must match old code and cancellation semantics
scheduler.targets: Existing one-time targets for KST 23h/06h plus periodic reconciliation; local generation unconstrained by network
scheduler.retry: Bounded exponential backoff for known retryable failures, persisted nextAttemptAt and attemptCount; permanent failure stays visible until manual retry
scheduler.cancellation: Persistent generation increment fences in-flight commits; cancel OS work after durable disable
scheduler.recovery: Reboot WorkManager persistence + app ensure; crashes recover unfinished durable work without reissuing ACKed revisions
scheduler.backlog: Process oldest pending days in bounded batches; persist cursor after each commit; never discard backlog by limiting batch size
scheduler.forceStop: No promise of execution while OS force-stopped; reconcile after app launch
scheduler.deliveryUncertainty: If provider cannot reconcile or honor idempotency key, UNKNOWN requires explicit review/manual retry with duplicate-risk notice
